text: Scenario 4: control-rod insertion (prescribed power reduction)

The reactor power, and with it the fission rate in the kernel, is reduced along an assumed history and the temperature falls correspondingly. STRATO models only the consequence for the generation rate and the temperature, not the rod or the core.
